<br>

  Hi, I’m Alexa, a master's student at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health. 
  
  I am working toward a Master of Public Health in Epidemiology with a certificate in Epidemiology of Chronic Disease. 
  
  My academic interests include environmental and occupational epidemiology, with a focus on understanding and addressing population-level health risks.
